## Runs 6–7 — SdH spot checks at D = 0 (`sdh-spot-check`, investigation Step 3)

**Run 6, electron n = +3.2×10¹² (F_L = 33.1 T).** Clean, deep oscillations (dips toward zero above ~5 T — SdH→QH regime). Tracked tones: a **strong light tone at 7.1 T** (SNR 40, censored at the record's low edge — alive to at least ~1 T; below that the 50 mT coarse leg can't resolve it), and a high cluster **22.1 / 29.5 T** (onsets 1.4/1.9 T) that the tracker flags as 3×/4× harmonics of 7.1, plus a 14.1 T (2×). Model (fs_count_b0, run-5 cal): **ABAB predicts 7.4 + 25.9 T (0.22/0.78·F_L)** — the measured 7.1 matches the light pocket, and the expected heavy tone at ~26 T sits **between** the 3× (21.3) and 4× (28.4) harmonics, unresolvable from them in a single column (heavy-cluster δF ≈ 2.0–2.4 T, onset-limited). **ABCA predicts a lone singleton at 33.1 T** — no isolated F_L tone, but 29.5 = 0.89·F_L is inside the lever-arm scale band, and a strong 7.1 tone is not in the ABCA template. Per the investigation's harmonic screen this is **exactly the case the n-trajectory decides**: a harmonic tracks k·f₁(n); the ABAB heavy tracks F_L(n) − f₁(n); ABCA tracks F_L(n).

**Run 7, hole n = −1.2×10¹² (F_L = 12.4 T).** The predicted near-CNP exception regime (ABAB pair 5.9/6.5 T, close and balanced). Measured: crowded set — 6.6 (SNR 85), 4.7, 8.5, 9.4, 12.3 (SNR 125, ≈ F_L — pair-sum/breakdown candidate: 5.9+6.5 = 12.4), 14.8, 26.2. Qualitatively consistent with the ABAB near-CNP template + sum tone, but **uninformative for the call by design** (tones merge within δF; hole side caps at −1.27×10¹²).

**Take (Step 3 → Step 4 handoff):** consistent-with **ABAB** on both sides, not decisive from single columns. Electron side is the fan side: tones separate, high-|n| reach to +3.25×10¹², onset ≲ 1 T. The fan inherits: B_lo = 1.0 T, Δ(1/B) = 0.01 T⁻¹, sensitivity re-sized for the low-n corner (below).

# Runs 6-7 — SdH spot checks (`sdh-spot-check`), D = 0: electron n=+3.2e12 (run 6, B 0->10 T), hole n=-1.2e12 (run 7, B 10->0.3 T)
from hera.analysis import sdh_onset, SdhOnsetError

SENS, BIAS_R, SR1_GAIN = 50e-6, 100e6, 1.0   # both runs: sr1 50 uV, 1 V drive / 100 MOhm -> 10 nA
FL_E, FL_H = 33.1, 12.4                      # Luttinger F_L = (h/4e)n at the two spots (run-5 cal)
# model (fs_count_b0, run in scratch): ABAB @ +3.2e12: 7.4/25.9 T (0.22/0.78 FL); ABCA: 33.1 T singleton
# ABAB @ -1.2e12: 5.9/6.5 T (near-CNP balanced pair); ABCA: 12.4 T (m* 1.1 -> LK-dead at T_e ~ 8 K)
MODEL = {6: dict(FL=FL_E, abab=(7.4, 25.9), abca=33.1), 7: dict(FL=FL_H, abab=(5.9, 6.5), abca=12.4)}

fig, axes = plt.subplots(2, 3, figsize=(15, 7.5))
onsets = {}
for row, (rid, lab) in enumerate([(6, "run 6 — electron n=+3.2e12"), (7, "run 7 — hole n=-1.2e12")]):
    r = run(rid)
    B, Rr = r.col("magnet_field"), (r.col("sr1_X") / SR1_GAIN) / (1.0 / BIAS_R)
    o = np.argsort(B); B, Rr = B[o], Rr[o]
    print(f"=== {lab}: R = {Rr[0]:.0f} Ohm at B_min, max {Rr.max():.0f} Ohm ({Rr.max()/(SENS/1e-8)*100:.0f}% of FS)")
    on = sdh_onset(Rr, B, r_full_scale=SENS / 1e-8)
    print(on.summary()); onsets[rid] = on

    ax = axes[row, 0]                                    # raw FIRST
    ax.plot(B, Rr, lw=0.5); ax.set_xlabel("B (T)"); ax.set_ylabel("Rxx (Ohm)"); ax.set_title(lab + " — raw")

    msk = B > 0.5                                        # bg-subtracted
    dR = Rr[msk] - np.polyval(np.polyfit(B[msk], Rr[msk], 5), B[msk])
    ax = axes[row, 1]
    ax.plot(B[msk], dR, lw=0.5); ax.axvline(on.onset_b, color="r", ls="--", label=f"onset(track) {on.onset_b:.2f} T")
    ax.set_xlabel("B (T)"); ax.set_ylabel("dRxx (Ohm)"); ax.set_title("bg-subtracted (deg-5 in B)"); ax.legend(fontsize=8)

    ax = axes[row, 2]                                    # 1/B FFT above 1 T (grid Nyquist-clean band)
    for cut, deg, st in [(1.0, 5, "-"), (1.5, 5, "--"), (1.0, 7, ":")]:
        f, s = sdh_fft(Rr[:, None], B, b_range=(cut, B.max()), bg_degree=deg, log=False, nfft=4096)
        band = f >= 2.5
        ax.plot(f[band], s[0][band] / s[0][band].max(), st, lw=1, label=f"cut {cut} T, deg {deg}")
    m = MODEL[rid]
    ax.axvline(m["FL"], color="k", alpha=0.5, label=f"F_L {m['FL']} T (=ABCA)")
    for fm in m["abab"]:
        ax.axvline(fm, color="tab:green", alpha=0.5, ls="--")
    ax.plot([], [], color="tab:green", ls="--", label=f"ABAB model {m['abab']} T")
    ax.set_xlim(0, m["FL"] * 1.5); ax.set_xlabel("F (T)"); ax.set_ylabel("norm. amp (f>2.5 T)")
    ax.set_title("FFT in 1/B"); ax.legend(fontsize=7)
fig.tight_layout(); plt.show()

## HERA — Step 4: Landau fan, electron side (`landau-fan-vti`), D = 0 — the stacking discriminator

> **05:29** · landau-fan-vti electron: n +1.00->+3.25e12 (71 cols, D=0, run-5 cal), B 1->10 T uniform-1/B (91 rows, d(1/B)=0.01), sr1 100 uV, fast\_delay 1.8 s; ends 10 T, gates parked · **ETA ~10:44** (≈5h15m)

**Why this fan (from runs 6–7, ana):** the electron spot check shows the ABAB light tone (7.1 T vs model 7.4 T) but its high-tone cluster (22.1 / 29.5 T) confounds the ABAB heavy tone (model 25.9 T at +3.2e12) with the 3×/4× harmonics of 7.1 — and 29.5 T = 0.89·F_L is also inside the ABCA scale band. Single columns cannot decide; the **n-trajectory screen can**: over n = 1.0 → 3.25×10¹², the model's ABAB heavy runs 9.8 → 26.2 T, 3×f₁ runs 1.7 → 22.4 T, 4×f₁ 2.3 → 29.9 T, and ABCA's F_L 10.3 → 33.5 T — divergent by ≫ δF across the window. Electron side per the investigation's cleaner-side rule (hole side is the predicted near-CNP exception regime and caps at −1.27×10¹²). **Coverage trade, stated:** the hole side is excluded from this fan — its templates merge within resolution at reachable |n| (run 7), so hole coverage would cost ~5 h for a resolvability-limited read; the electron fan carries the claim.

**Design (recipe step-1 checks, computed):** per-column SdH-FFT fan, uniform 1/B. **B-axis:** Δ(1/B) = 0.01 T⁻¹ → 91 rows, 1 → 10 T ascending; FFT Nyquist 50 T ≥ 1.2·F_L(n_max) = 41 T and the measured 4× comb (~30 T); inherits the spot check's fine-leg spacing at its low edge. **B_lo = 1.0 T:** the carrying tone is censored at run 6's analysis edge (0.30 T) but grid-resolvable only ≥ ~0.85 T on its coarse leg, and the claim tones (heavy cluster) onset at 1.4–1.9 T — a lower B_lo buys no δF on them, only cost. **B_max = 10 T** = session cap; the heavy-cluster δF (≈ 2.0–2.4 T, onset-limited) is what B_max shortens, so take it all. **n-axis:** 71 cols = 3× ray-Nyquist at 1 T (Δn_ray = 9.7×10¹⁰; 23.3 periods across the window); n_max = +3.25×10¹² is the TG-validator edge (Vtg +0.998 V). **Dynamic range:** 100 µV = 10 kΩ FS, sized to the low-n × high-B corner (ν ≈ 4.2 QH peaks, ~kΩ; ~17× the run-7 anchor), run-4's rail lesson applied. **Dwell:** fast_delay 1.8 s = 6τ (τ = 0.3 s / 24 dB — per-column-FFT case, recipe step 7); slow_delay 1.

**Price (calibrated on runs 5–7):** grid 91×71 × 1.9 s/pt (1.8 dwell + 0.10 reads, run-5 within-row) = 3.4 h + ramps 73 min (0→1 position + 1→10 traverse at 0.137 T/min) + settles/turnaround ~7 min ≈ **4.8 h computed → 5 h 15 m realistic**. Ends at **10 T, gates parked at 0**. **Checkpoints:** first rows (~10 min in — rail/leakage/dead channel/field tracking); interim per-column FFT reads at rows ~30 (B ≈ 1.4 T) and ~60 (B ≈ 2.7 T) — the light tone f₁(n) should already track; abort there if the channel rails or columns are flat. In-arc (investigation Step 4), monitored via backgrounded `hera-watch --follow`.

# === Landau fan, electron side (`landau-fan-vti`): D = 0, n = +1.00 -> +3.25e12, B 1 -> 10 T uniform-1/B ===
from sharpelab_nb.gates import calc_gate_voltages

# --- session calibration from run 5 (cnp-and-dline-calibration) ---
CAL = dict(c_tg=2.796e-03, c_bg=2.161e-03, n_offset=-0.0894, D_offset=-0.013)
N_N, N_B = 71, 91
ns = np.linspace(1.00, 3.25, N_N)                 # 1e12 cm^-2; 3x ray-Nyquist at B_lo = 1 T (23.3 periods)
Ds = np.zeros(N_N)                                # D = 0 (the investigation's operating point)
Vtg_vec, Vbg_vec = calc_gate_voltages(ns, Ds, CAL["c_tg"], CAL["c_bg"], CAL["n_offset"], CAL["D_offset"])
assert Vtg_vec.min() >= TG_MIN and Vtg_vec.max() <= TG_MAX and Vbg_vec.min() >= BG_MIN and Vbg_vec.max() <= BG_MAX, \
    (Vtg_vec.min(), Vtg_vec.max(), Vbg_vec.min(), Vbg_vec.max())
B_vec = field_invB(1.0, 10.0, N_B)                # Delta(1/B) = 0.01 /T -> FFT Nyquist 50 T >= 1.2*F_L(n_max) = 41 T
assert B_vec.max() <= B_SESSION_CAP and B_vec.min() >= 1.0

# --- preconditions (assumed, not set) ---
assert_thermometry_live("T_sample", VTI.temp_logfile_candidates["T_sample"], max_age=15, max_period=12)
_T0, _B0 = T_sample(), magnet.field()
print(f"precondition T_sample = {_T0:.3f} K (1.0-1.5), B = {_B0:+.4f} T (|B|<0.05: fan positions to 1 T), "
      f"V_si = {k_si():+.3f} V (0), PS heater {magnet.persistent_switch_on()}, output {magnet.output_enabled()}")
assert 1.0 <= _T0 <= 1.5 and abs(_B0) < 0.05 and abs(k_si()) < 0.01
assert magnet.persistent_switch_on() and magnet.output_enabled()
_tau, _slope = sr1.time_constant(), sr1.filter_slope()
print(f"sr1 tau = {_tau} s, slope = {_slope} dB/oct  (fast_delay 1.8 s = 6*tau, keyed to 0.3 s / 24 dB)")
assert abs(_tau - 0.3) < 1e-3 and _slope == 24, "lock-in settling changed on the front panel - re-derive the dwell"

# Fixed sensitivity for the whole fan, sized to the global worst corner (low n x high B: nu ~ 4.2 at
# (+1.0e12, 10 T), QH Rxx peaks ~ kOhm): 100 uV = 10 kOhm FS at 10 nA, ~17x the run-7 near-CNP anchor
# (576 Ohm at 10 T). Run-6 max (522 Ohm) sits at 5% FS - lose low-R resolution rather than clip a column.
sr1.sensitivity(100e-6)
I_TRIP = 1e-9
print(f"grid: {N_B} B-rows (uniform 1/B) x {N_N} n-cols; Vtg {Vtg_vec.min():+.4f}..{Vtg_vec.max():+.4f} V, "
      f"Vbg {Vbg_vec.min():+.4f}..{Vbg_vec.max():+.4f} V; sr1 sens {sr1.sensitivity()} V")

mc = dict(meas_config); mc["Si (V)"] = k_si(); mc["sample_temperature:"] = _T0
mc["comments"] = (f"landau-fan-vti electron side: n = +1.00 -> +3.25e12 ({N_N} cols), D = 0 (run-5 cal), "
                  f"B = 1 -> 10 T uniform-1/B ({N_B} rows, d(1/B) = 0.01 /T), sr1 100 uV, fast_delay 1.8 s")
s = sweep.AsyncStation(mc)
s.add_comment('landau-fan-vti')
s.add_comment(f'electron side, D = +0.00 V/nm: n = +1.00 -> +3.25e12 cm^-2 ({N_N} cols), B = 1 -> 10 T uniform-1/B '
              f'({N_B} rows, d(1/B) = 0.01 /T); (Vtg, Vbg) = ({Vtg_vec.min():+.4f}..{Vtg_vec.max():+.4f}, '
              f'{Vbg_vec.min():+.4f}..{Vbg_vec.max():+.4f}) V; sr1 100 uV, tau 0.3 s / 24 dB, fast_delay 1.8 s (6 tau); '
              f'cal run 5: ratio {CAL["c_bg"]/CAL["c_tg"]:.3f}, n_offset {CAL["n_offset"]:+.3f}e12, D_offset {CAL["D_offset"]:+.3f}')
s.ramp(k_bg.volt, Vbg_vec[0]); s.ramp(k_tg.volt, Vtg_vec[0])
interruptible_sleep(10)

# row layout: [time, B, Vtg, Vbg, T_sample, k_tg.curr, k_bg.curr, sr0.X, sr0.P, sr1.X, sr1.P]
s.fp(T_sample).fp(k_tg.curr).fp(k_bg.curr)
s.fp(sr0.X).fp(sr0.P).fp(sr1.X).fp(sr1.P)
s.plot(k_tg.volt, sr1.X); s.plot(k_tg.volt, sr0.X); s.plot('time', k_tg.curr); s.plot('time', k_bg.curr)

def leak_guard(station, data):
    i_tg, i_bg = abs(float(data[5])), abs(float(data[6]))
    if i_tg > I_TRIP or i_bg > I_TRIP:
        print(f"LEAK TRIP at B={float(data[1]):+.3f} T, Vtg={float(data[2]):+.4f} V: "
              f"|I_tg|={i_tg:.3e}, |I_bg|={i_bg:.3e} A")
        station.interrupt_requested = True
s.register_run_after(leak_guard, ())

s.multimegasweep([magnet.field], [B_vec], [k_tg.volt, k_bg.volt], [Vtg_vec, Vbg_vec],
                 slow_delay=1, fast_delay=1.8)

# park gates at 0; field stays at 10 T deliberately (next step - LK ladder or hole-side work - starts high
# and rides down; never re-traverse).
s.ramp(k_tg.volt, 0.0); s.ramp(k_bg.volt, 0.0)
print(f"done: B = {magnet.field():+.3f} T, gates parked at 0 V; T_sample = {T_sample():.3f} K")
